body.message:
Hi, I’m looking for a furnished studio or 1-bedroom apartment in Dubai from 6 October for one month, with the possibility of extending for another month.

My preferred areas are Business Bay, Downtown, Dubai Marina, or Riviera. I’m looking for a high-quality apartment with a nice view, balcony if possible, fully equipped kitchen, and good building facilities.

My maximum budget is AED 5,000 per month, preferably including bills.

Please send me the best available options with photos, location, price, and what is included. Thank you!
